family_reports.body: San Diego County, San Diego County Sheriff Dept, Health and Human Services Child Welfare Services and the Juvenile Depenancy & Deliquency Courtroom 10 Meadowlark Location Made me Homeless for the First time in my life, took away the housing help I had for our family, THEN denied to offer services requested in order to not be homeless, Ignored a Childs Metal Health Disabilities, are letting CHILDREN make their own mental health decisions. THE COUNTY OF SAN DIEGO is teaching our children its okay to hit thier parents and its okay to hit inocent people in our county. That its okay to lie to police, judges, Social workers, family, and that our own children don't have to listen to their mother or father. #CPSMadeMeHomeless
The system has taken us completely back in time, I FEEL LIKE A SLAVE! It feels as though my daughter is being auctioned off to the highest bidder.
